function.name: SetTypes
function.description: Sets the new module's location, imports and type declarations. Call again to replace them.

component.description: The component the module belongs to, exactly as listed: a package name for its library, or package:exe:name for an executable

module.description: Name of the new module, e.g. Billing.Invoice. It must not already exist.

imports.description: Complete import lines, e.g. "import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map"

types.description: Type declarations and instances only: no module header, imports or functions
